description: Verified against Letterboxd 3.5.8. More resilient patch anchors and a hardened Stremio/Nuvio launch fallback, so the patches keep applying reliably after app updates.

patches.name: Add Stremio button
patches.description: Adds a purple Stremio button directly below the trailer button on film pages, styled identically to it. Takes the trailer button's position when there is no trailer. Opens the film directly in the Stremio app or web player.

patches.name: Hide Spotlight Ad
patches.description: Hides the sponsored "Spotlight" ad card on the home feed. Can be toggled independently of the other patches.

patches.name: Hide Video Store
patches.description: Hides the "Rent from Letterboxd Video Store" banner on film pages, the video store carousel row on the home feed, and the "Letterboxd Video Store" row in the search page's "Browse by" list. Can be toggled independently of the other patches.

patches.name: Hide Where to Watch
patches.description: Hides the "Where to watch" streaming-service icon row on film pages. Can be toggled independently of the other patches.

release_notes: Verified against Letterboxd 3.5.8. More resilient patch anchors and a hardened Stremio/Nuvio launch fallback, so the patches keep applying reliably after app updates.
repoDescription: Morphe patches for the Letterboxd app: Stremio/Nuvio button, hide video store, hide where-to-watch row, and hide Spotlight ad promos
